mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investments, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within two months indicates a weakening economy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when UNRATE rises by more than 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real estate activity, measured by a rise in housing starts by more than 5% over three months, signals a strengthening economy and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when HOUST rises by more than 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production by more than 2% over two months signals a reduction in supply-side capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when INDPRO declines by more than 2%.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls increase by more than 200,000 over a month, it signals strong labor market conditions, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances when PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction between rising consumer prices (CPIAUCSL) and falling real disposable income (RSAFS) indicates a squeeze on consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when CPIAUCSL rises and RSAFS falls simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate below 2% for more than 6 months signals a prolonged accommodative monetary policy, which supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the periods when FEDFUNDS is below 2% for more than 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising GDP (GDPC1) and falling unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a robust economic expansion, which boosts corporate earnings and investor sentiment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when GDPC1 rises and UNRATE falls simultaneously.
